title: Get a permit to run a market
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running a market on council property or a public place.

laws.title: Town of Mosman Park Local Government Property, Activities and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2025

sources.title: Town of Mosman Park Local Government Property, Activities and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2025
sources.locator: cl 6.9, as made, Gazette No. 68, 11 Jun 2025
sources.quote: A person shall not set up or conduct a market in a public place—

sources.title: Town of Mosman Park Local Government Property, Activities and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2025
sources.locator: cl 6.9, as made, Gazette No. 68, 11 Jun 2025
sources.quote: (a) unless the person is the holder of a valid and current permit;

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 23, 6 Mar 2026); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Running a market on council land needs the council's permit.

marks.reason: A permit, set days and times, and conditions.
